about: ElevenLabs Sound Effects v2 prompts for the ZEN Design Team sound layer (direction A: the world real and quiet, the Zeneks toys). Generated by scripts/sfx.mjs into sound-raw/<cue>/ (local only), auditioned, and the picks placed in public/sound/. Prompts are kept dry and isolated: the app gives every sound one shared space. Durations are always set (10 credits a second on this plan).

lake.use: the lake at the deck's posts (bed, near bus)
lake.prompt: Field recording of calm lake water gently lapping against wooden dock posts, soft irregular small waves, close perspective, peaceful early morning, high-quality stereo ambience

breeze.use: a breeze over the hills (bed, far bus)
breeze.prompt: Field recording of a soft gentle breeze over open grassy hills, faint distant rustle of leaves, wide airy stereo ambience, calm and quiet, high-quality

songbird.use: a bird on the hills, now and then
songbird.prompt: A single common blackbird singing one short melodious phrase in the distance across a quiet valley, clear natural birdsong, isolated, high-quality field recording

uguisu.use: the Japanese bush warbler, now and then
uguisu.prompt: A Japanese bush warbler (uguisu) singing its classic call hoo-hokekyo once, distant, clear, isolated, spring morning, high-quality field recording

gulls.use: the gulls as they cross the sky
gulls.prompt: Two seagulls calling briefly far away over calm water, distant and soft, isolated calls, high-quality field recording

fish.use: a fish rising where a ring blooms
fish.prompt: A small fish jumping and plopping once into a still lake, distant, gentle single plop, isolated, high-quality field recording

click.use: every control but the sound's own
click.prompt: A single delicate click of a fingertip tapping a small box of hard wood, very short, crisp and soft, dry, close-mic, isolated

boop.use: a Zenek tapped (pitched to its note, bent along its squash)
boop.prompt: One soft squeeze of a small squishy rubber toy ball, a short cute rounded boop, gentle, dry, close-mic, isolated

plip.prompt: A single water droplet falling into a small ceramic bowl of water, soft round plink, dry, close-mic, isolated

splash.prompt: A fingertip dipping into still water, one small delicate splash with a few droplets falling back, close, dry, isolated

bowl.prompt: A single soft strike of a small Japanese rin singing bowl with a padded mallet, pure clear tone, long natural decay, dry, isolated

pen.use: the title being written (played faster and louder with the pen's speed)
pen.prompt: Close-mic recording of a felt-tip ink pen writing continuously on thick textured cotton paper, steady soft scratching, dry, isolated

dot.prompt: A pen tip tapping once on thick paper on a wooden desk, soft single tap, dry, close-mic, isolated

chime.use: the title letting go into petals
chime.prompt: A small Japanese glass wind bell (furin) ringing softly two or three times in a light breeze, delicate and clear, isolated, high-quality

air.use: the breath of air under the petals
air.prompt: A soft rising breath of warm air, delicate airy whoosh that swells and fades, gentle, isolated

kalimba.use: the fourteen arriving (pitched to each one's note)
kalimba.prompt: A single soft kalimba note plucked with the thumb, middle register, warm and clean, one note only, dry, close-mic, isolated

bell.use: the title letting go: two or three strikes, timed by the app
bell.prompt: A single strike of a small Japanese glass wind bell (furin), one clear delicate ding with a natural ringing decay, isolated, high-quality
